title: Real REMAX Group CEO and President Named HousingWire Vanguard Award Winners
summary: Tamir Poleg and Jenna Rozenblat are recognized for their ‘leadership, vision and influence’ across the housing industry.
body_markdown:
Real REMAX Group Chairman and CEO Tamir Poleg and Real REMAX Group President Jenna Rozenblat have been named recipients of the[2026 HousingWire Vanguard award](https://www.housingwire.com/articles/announcing-the-2026-housingwire-vanguards/) , earning recognition among 100 housing leaders whose leadership and strategic vision are helping shape the future of the industry.


##


Tamir Poleg, Chairman and CEO, Real REMAX Group


##


Jenna Rozenblat, President, Real REMAX Group


“We’re honored to be recognized by *HousingWire* , especially during such an important moment for our organization,” Poleg says. “We believe that when we give agents, brokers and franchisees better tools, better support and the freedom to build their businesses their way, the entire industry moves forward. This recognition reflects the work being done across the networks and our commitment to helping real estate professionals thrive in a rapidly changing market.”


Together, Poleg and Rozenblat have helped guide a vision centered on empowering agents, brokers and franchisees. Their leadership has focused on creating new opportunities through technology and innovation while maintaining the entrepreneurial spirit that has long defined the real estate profession.


Rozenblat said the award underscores the value of bringing together strong brands, strong leadership and a shared commitment to real estate professionals.


“Our focus has always been on creating an environment where agents and brokers can grow, adapt and better serve their clients,” Rozenblat says. “This recognition is a reflection of the collaboration, resilience and entrepreneurial mindset that exists throughout the Real REMAX Group network. We’re excited about what we can accomplish together as we continue building for the future.”


Now in its 12th year, the Vanguard program honors executives across real estate, mortgage and homebuilding who have made a lasting impact on their organizations and the broader housing economy, recognizing leaders who successfully navigate complex market challenges, drive meaningful change and position their companies for long-term success.


Written by **REMAX News**
